observations.body: Mark 5:1–15 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is given and enters; the wording centers on “Immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.”

payload.posture: Read Mark 5:1–15 as evidence about the Spirit, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states mark 5:1–15 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is given and enters; the wording centers on “Immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
